transcript: Speaker A: Ye dekh 40 hajar ki job lag gayi hai meri, haste the na tum log? mazak udate the meri english ka. Now many companies are calling me, even the HR was so impressed with my English, and today I got the job. [Look, I got a job of 40,000, you guys used to laugh, right? You used to make fun of my English. Now many companies are calling me, even the HR was so impressed with my English, and today I got the job.] Speaker B: Are waah shreya! koi mehenga course liya hoga na? itni jaldi english bolna kese sikh gyi? [Oh wow Shreya! You must have taken some expensive course, right? How did you learn to speak English so quickly?] Speaker A: Thank god 2 weeks pehle mujhe SpeakX app mil gayi. [Thank god I found the SpeakX app 2 weeks ago.] Speaker B: SpeakX app? Speaker A: Haan, isme ek AI English Teacher hai. Mai uske saath har din 10 se 15 minute bina kisi judgment ke English practice karti thi. [Yes, it has an AI English Teacher. I used to practice English with her for 10 to 15 minutes every day without any judgment.] Speaker A: SIA AI roz meri interview ki preparation karwati thi, jaise... Tell me about yourself. Why should we hire you? And what are your strengths? [SIA AI used to prepare me for interviews every day, like... Tell me about yourself. Why should we hire you? And what are your strengths?] Speaker A: Aur sabse achhi baat? Main jab bhi galti karti thi, AI turant usko correct kar deti thi. [And the best part? Whenever I made a mistake, the AI would correct it immediately.] Speaker A: Pehle interviews mein English bolte waqt confidence hi nahi hota tha. Par is app ne Mock interviews, daily speaking practice, vocabulary improvement, pronunciation correction... Sab sahi kar diya. [Earlier, I didn't have confidence while speaking English in interviews. But this app fixed everything: Mock interviews, daily speaking practice, vocabulary improvement, pronunciation correction...] Speaker B: Arey wah yaar, par mehenga bhi hoga na? [Oh wow, but it must be expensive too, right?] Speaker A: sirf 2 rupaye mein 7 din ka trial le sakte ho. [You can get a 7-day trial for just 2 rupees.] Speaker B: Mera bhi interview hai 2 week mai, mere phone mai bhi download karde SpeakX app. [I also have an interview in 2 weeks, download the SpeakX app on my phone too.]
